Description: FIA ecodivisions (the primary strata); Id = StrtmId
US states (TIGER 2009); Id = state FIPS. The CONUS 1km secondary strata
Watershed basins (WBD HU6); Id = HUC6 code
Watershed subbasins (WBD HU8); Id = HUC8 code
EPA Level III ecoregions (dissolved from Level IV); Id = L3 code
FSim / WRC pyromes (RDS-2020-0020); Id = pyrome number
Federal and tribal fee land by owner (PAD-US 4.0 Own_Name; tribal land = BIA); other land = Non Federal. The CONUS 1km tertiary strata (then from the National Atlas fedlanp010g)
PAD-US 4.0 GAP status (the state geodatabases' combined layer; the most protected status where areas overlap); other land = Not in PAD-US
National Park Service units by name (PAD-US 4.0 NPS fee land, Unit_Nm); Id from nps-units-crosswalk.csv. For a study area of one park; other land = Not National Park Service land

National Wildlife Refuge System units by name (PAD-US 4.0 FWS fee land of designation types NWR, NCA and RMA, Unit_Nm: refuges, FWS conservation areas, waterfowl production areas and wetland management districts; not hatcheries); Id from fws-refuges-crosswalk.csv. Other land = Not National Wildlife Refuge System land

Department of Defense installations by name (PAD-US 4.0 installation boundaries, Mang_Name DOD and Des_Tp MIL, Unit_Nm; land inside a boundary counts whoever owns it); Id from dod-installations-crosswalk.csv. Other land = Not Department of Defense land

National forests and grasslands by name (PAD-US 4.0 Forest Service fee land, Unit_Nm; inholdings are not part of them); Id from national-forests-crosswalk.csv. Other land = Not National Forest System land
Designated wilderness by name, any manager (PAD-US 4.0 Des_Tp WA, Unit_Nm); overlaps the parks, forests and refuges. Id from wilderness-crosswalk.csv. Other land = Not designated wilderness
Federally recognized reservations with their off-reservation trust land, and state reservations (TIGER/Line 2022 AIANNH); Id = AIANNHCE. Other land = Not tribal land

BLM national monuments, national conservation areas and wilderness study areas by name (PAD-US 4.0 designations NM, NCA, WSA); Id from blm-ncl-crosswalk.csv. Other land = Not BLM National Conservation Lands

Metropolitan statistical areas (OMB July 2023), whole counties; Id = CBSA code, from msa-crosswalk.csv (county GEOID). Connecticut's old counties take their planning region's metro. Other land = Not in a metropolitan area

Each cell's land manager by unit name: National Park Service units, then National Wildlife Refuges, national forests and grasslands, DoD installations and tribal lands, each from its own source and in that order where their boundaries overlap; all other land takes its Federal Lands owner class. A stack of other sources: it has no polygons or units of its own (user 2026-11-20: Secondary Strata = Land Manager)
Stack: National Parks;FWS Refuges;National Forests;DoD Installations;Tribal Lands;Federal Lands

Description: Each cell's designation by unit name: designated wilderness, then the BLM National Conservation Lands (monuments, conservation areas, wilderness study areas); all other land = Not designated wilderness. A stack of other sources: it has no polygons or units of its own (user 2026-11-20: Tertiary Strata = Land Designation)
